questions.stem: A 16-year-old male presents to the clinic complaining of recurrent pain and swelling near the anterior margin of his right ear. Upon examination, a small opening is noted anterior to the tragus with signs of local infection. His medical history is notable for similar episodes over the past two years, which were managed conservatively. Considering his recurrent symptoms and the chronic nature of the condition, which of the following is the most appropriate management for this patient?
